summary.text: Cate Brennan is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 98, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a nonprofit executive director with a background in national healthcare associations.

paragraphs.text: Cate Brennan graduated from Thomas Jefferson-Dallas High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Texas in 1984 and a graduate degree from Texas Woman's University in 2004.
Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive director.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in North Texas since 1970, was a two-time CEO and spent more than 25 years as a senior executive with national nonprofit healthcare associations, and now lives in Grapevine.
She also said she volunteers as a precinct chair, committee chair for the Tarrant County Democratic Party, poll worker and volunteer deputy registrar.

Brennan said in the survey that her campaign priorities include restoring full funding for public schools and repealing school vouchers, raising the minimum wage to $20 an hour, and establishing free or low-cost early childhood education and childcare programs.
She faces Republican Armin Mizani in the general election for a seat with no incumbent.
